review_notes: Read the whole target file and the PrimeSpectrum/Reconstruction sources it relies on. Confirmed that the prime-ideal pullback construction and the order-isomorphism proof are each written twice (private copy + inline copy, tied together by `rfl` bridge lemmas). Also found a third repeated block, "compact open ⇒ basicOpen of a principal ideal", in two proofs here and in Reconstruction.lean. I did not compile any rewrites. The proposed `comapIdeal`-based definition should unify by `rfl` with existing uses, since the bridge lemmas are `rfl` today. Whether `private` helpers can be used in a public `@[expose]` def under the module system is a small uncertainty; the helpers can be made non-private.

findings.problem: The pullback ideal construction (nonempty via map_bot, directed via map_sup, lower via monotonicity) and the primeness proof (isProper via map_top, of_mem_or_mem via map_inf) are written out in full twice. First they appear as `comapIdeal` / `comapIdeal_isPrime`. Then they appear again verbatim inside the body of `spectrumComap`. The two copies are only tied together by the `rfl` lemma `spectrumComap_eq_privateConstruction`, which exists solely to witness the duplication and has no mathematical content. Any change to the pullback proof must be made in both places.
findings.proposed_change: Define `spectrumComap f := fun P ↦ ⟨comapIdeal f P.1, comapIdeal_isPrime f P.1 P.2⟩`. Make the two helpers non-private if the module/expose system requires it, since the def is `@[expose]`. Then delete the inline ideal and primeness block (lines 73–95) and the `rfl` bridge `spectrumComap_eq_privateConstruction`. All later lemmas (`spectrumComap_preimage_basicOpen_principal`, `spectrumComap_id`, `spectrumComap_comp`) are stated about `spectrumComap` and are `rfl`-based or membership-based, so they are unchanged.
findings.benefit: Removes about 30 lines of duplicated nontrivial proof and a vacuous bridge lemma. There is one place to maintain the pullback-prime argument.

findings.problem: The order-embedding proof (`basicOpen_subset_iff`, `principal_le_iff`, `mem_principal`) and the surjectivity proof (open ⇒ basicOpen I, compact ⇒ I principal) are stated as private declarations `principalCompactOpenEmbedding` and `principalCompactOpen_surjective`. They are then pasted again as `let` bindings inside `compactOpenOrderIso`. A `rfl` bridge lemma exists only to record that the copies agree.
findings.proposed_change: Define `compactOpenOrderIso := OrderIso.ofSurjective principalCompactOpenEmbedding principalCompactOpen_surjective`. Delete the two `let` blocks (lines 170–186) and `compactOpenOrderIso_eq_privateConstruction`. `compactOpenOrderIso_apply` stays `rfl`, because `OrderIso.ofSurjective` applied to `a` reduces to `principalCompactOpen a`, exactly as it does now.
findings.benefit: Eliminates a duplicated 17-line surjectivity proof and a duplicated embedding proof. The public definition becomes a one-line description of its construction, and the bridge lemma disappears.

findings.declaration: isSpectralMap_spectrumComap / principalCompactOpen_surjective (shared 'compact open is a principal basic open' reasoning)
findings.problem: Both `isSpectralMap_spectrumComap` and `principalCompactOpen_surjective` run the same argument. Take an open compact set `s`; choose an ideal `I` with `basicOpen I = s` via `isOpen_iff_exists_basicOpen`; transport compactness along the equality; apply `isCompact_basicOpen_iff` to get `I = principal a`. The same chain also appears in the inline copy in `compactOpenOrderIso` and in `Reconstruction.lean` (around line 90). Each use re-derives the same fact.
findings.proposed_change: Add one lemma next to `isCompact_basicOpen_iff`: `theorem exists_principal_eq_of_isCompact_of_isOpen {s : Set (PrimeIdealSpectrum A)} (ho : IsOpen s) (hc : IsCompact s) : ∃ a : A, basicOpen (Order.Ideal.principal a) = s`. Proof: obtain `⟨I, hI⟩ := (isOpen_iff_exists_basicOpen s).mp ho`, `subst hI`, `obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (isCompact_basicOpen_iff I).mp hc`, `exact ⟨a, rfl⟩`. Then in `isSpectralMap_spectrumComap`, after `intro s hsOpen hsCompact`, do `obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := exists_principal_eq_of_isCompact_of_isOpen hsOpen hsCompact`, `rw [spectrumComap_preimage_basicOpen_principal]`, and `exact isCompact_basicOpen_principal (f a)` (or the existing `isCompact_basicOpen_iff _ |>.mpr ⟨f a, rfl⟩`). In the surjectivity proof, do `obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_principal_eq_of_isCompact_of_isOpen U.isOpen U.isCompact`, then `exact ⟨a, TopologicalSpace.CompactOpens.ext ha⟩`. The same helper can replace the chain in `Reconstruction.lean`.
findings.benefit: Each caller shrinks from about 6 lines to 2–3, the open-and-compact characterization is stated once, and it can be reused across files.
